name: +1 Titan Evolution
creator: Bogdan's Games
redeem: Click the small Codes button (it says "COD.") in the top-right corner, next to the calendar and settings icons.
Type the code into the "Type a code..." box.
Press Redeem. "Code redeemed!" and the rewards show under the box.
notes:
+1 Titan Evolution is a Roblox "+1" clicker from Bogdan's Games, released in early October 2026 and inspired by Attack on Titan. Every click makes your character a little stronger, and you spend Wins on upgrades like Movement Speed, Punching Speed, Luck and Training Rate to evolve into bigger titans and move on through the worlds, starting with Liberia.

Pets give permanent multipliers, so the pet codes are the most valuable: THANKYOU gives the T-Bone Steak along with Wins and boosts. HALLOWEEN gave the Witch Cat during the Halloween event, which was listed to run until November 8, so it's now in the expired list. Use the Win and Power boosts together right before a long grinding session.

codes.reward: T-Bone Steak pet, 1,000 Wins, 2 Win Boosts and 2 Power Boosts

expired.reward: Witch Cat pet, 2,500 Skulls and 2 Luck Boosts

faq.q: Where is the code button in +1 Titan Evolution?
faq.a: At the top right of the screen: the small icon labelled "COD.", next to the calendar and the settings gear. It opens the Codes window.

faq.q: Does the HALLOWEEN code still work?
faq.a: The HALLOWEEN code was part of the Halloween event, which was listed to run until November 8, 2026, so I moved it to the expired list. It gave the Witch Cat pet, 2,500 Skulls and 2 Luck Boosts.

faq.q: Where does +1 Titan Evolution post new codes?
faq.a: The Codes window says new codes drop in the game's Roblox group and Discord.
